name: DSH Bridge
description: Drive an existing DeepSeek Harness desktop session from a chat app

enabled.description: Master switch for the forwarding hook

allowedSenders.description: Sender ids allowed to reach DeepSeek Harness. Empty means allow everyone, which is dangerous: this channel runs DSH with approvals disabled, so anyone who can message the bot could drive your machine.

allowGroups.description: Also forward group-chat messages. Default false.

bridgeUrl.description: Base URL of the DSH-side plugin routes. Default http://127.0.0.1:19387/phone-bridge

notifyUrl.description: Base URL of the notify plugin's pending question / approval endpoint. Default http://127.0.0.1:19387/dsh-notify

pageSize.description: Entries per page in the /list command. Default 15.

turnTimeoutMs.description: How long to wait for one answer before giving up, in milliseconds. Default 300000.

timeoutSeconds.description: Deprecated alias for turnTimeoutMs. Kept so an existing config keeps working.
